result.rationale: The controller does `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` with no nil check; update then calls `host.host = params[...]` and destroy calls `host.destroy` on a possibly-nil record, causing a 500 NoMethodError instead of a 404/success response. Directly verifiable in the new controller file.
